theorems.name: Submission.lpf_wtc_caf_lipschitz_localization
theorems.statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (K : Set (Eucl Q)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → IsCompact K → ∃ (s : Set (Eucl n)) (L : ℝ≥0), IsOpen s ∧ s ⊆ Ω ∧ Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' K ⊆ s ∧ Bornology.IsBounded s ∧ LipschitzOnWith L Φ s
